prevention_rule: Preserve all pending mutation impacts without cap; freeze before async authenticated write; clear only ACKed generation; leave newer edits queued and failed writes for retry; map finance and external sources to affected pages, explicitly label review-only and never infer financial outcomes or tenant acceptance.
release_gates: Required CI and CodeQL exact SHA
immutable Netlify preview and protected merge
two independently authorized customer tenant writes, sourceRevision, Brain ACK, Heartbeat and all influenced dashboards readbacks
negative cross-tenant authentication and read test
financial forecasts derived from legitimate source points with verified provider/provenance, never generated money
